description: Estimate how much revenue failed payments cost a business: the monthly amount at risk, the monthly amount not recovered and the yearly loss, from monthly revenue, payment failure rate and current recovery rate.

current_recovery_rate.description: Share of failed revenue already recovered today, as a percentage from 0 to 100. Use 0 if unknown.

failure_rate.description: Share of monthly revenue whose payment fails, as a percentage from 0 to 100.

monthly_revenue.description: Monthly recurring revenue, in dollars (or any single currency).
